description: Tradable assets on a chain; tag selects favorites or recommendations. Bridge targets→list_cross_chain_bridge_tokens.

account_id.description: User account ID. Only used when wallet is empty.

chain.description: Chain identifier, e.g. eth, bsc, solana, arbitrum. Omit to query all chains.

ignore_bridge.description: Ignore cross-chain bridge restrictions, only filter by chain. Default false.

search.description: Search keyword (token symbol or contract address)

search_auth.description: When searching, only return certified tokens. Only effective when search is non-empty.

tag.description: List type: empty for normal token list; 'favorite' for user favorites (requires wallet/account_id); 'recommend' for system recommended tokens.

wallet.description: User wallet address(es), comma-separated. Used for favorites and balance display.

web3_key.description: Chain web3_key identifier. Only used when chain is empty, auto-maps to chain.

name: dex_token_list_swap_tokens
